description: Find which weather forecast model had the lowest verified historical error (MAE) for a latitude/longitude coordinate (or station_or_report_id), weather variable (temperature, wind_speed, wind_direction, precipitation, humidity), and forecast horizon (Days 0-7). For wind_direction, errors are circular shortest-arc angular errors (0°–180°, where 359° vs 1° = 2° error) on speed-weighted hourly vector averages, returning both all-hours and >3 m/s active-wind rankings. For wind_speed the default is all hours, with an optional windier-days subset (daily mean scaled observed speed >= 3 m/s) returned separately. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning. Useful for solar & wind energy forecasting, agriculture & frost/irrigation risk, maritime/port & drone operations, construction planning, and microclimate evaluation. Provide (lat, lon) or station_or_report_id. Missing results stay unknown; not live forecasting.

station_or_report_id.description: Optional WeatherXM station UUID or custom site evaluation report ID (e.g. STUDY-...)

name: get_best_forecast_model
